source_arm: S1 trainable-table decisive checkpoint, with the complete graft restored to its seed-matched clean state before all backbone interventions

groups.embedding_and_head: input token embedding plus output unembedding
groups.attention_all: all attention parameters in all 24 decoder layers
groups.mlp_all: all MLP parameters in all 24 decoder layers
groups.normalization_all: all decoder and final layer-normalization parameters
groups.layers_00_05: all non-graft parameters in decoder layers 0 through 5
groups.layers_06_11: all non-graft parameters in decoder layers 6 through 11
groups.layers_12_17: all non-graft parameters in decoder layers 12 through 17
groups.layers_18_23: all non-graft parameters in decoder layers 18 through 23

interventions: sufficiency: clean backbone receives the poisoned delta for exactly one registered group
necessity: poisoned backbone has exactly one registered group restored to clean
endpoint_controls: complete poisoned backbone delta transplanted into clean checkpoint
complete poisoned backbone restored to clean

threshold_derivation.source: same deletion/routing resolution used by S1-S2e-G1-G2
threshold_derivation.interpretation: a component must independently account for at least the effect size the security assay was designed to resolve

decisions.component_sufficiency: lower endpoint of a two-sided 95% Student-t interval over five seed-level clean-adjusted ASR gains exceeds 0.15
decisions.component_necessity: lower endpoint of a two-sided 95% Student-t interval over five seed-level poisoned-ASR drops exceeds 0.15
decisions.endpoint_validity: both full-delta directions have lower 95% endpoints above 0.15 and both no-op conditions exactly reproduce their source ASR; failure invalidates component interpretation
decisions.no_compound_mechanism_gate: sufficiency and necessity are separate estimands; no group must pass both

verification: full replay of every endpoint and group evaluation from sealed S1 checkpoints; source/output manifests; raw disagreement and decision reproduction

budget.scale_justification: five independent source training seeds at both sizes estimate optimizer-run variability; 1024 held-out contexts retain the registered measurement resolution; all eight groups and both causal directions are enumerated rather than selected
